profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Energizer professional with extensive of software development and analysis experience utilizing Object Oriented Design at National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), NOAA,  and Department of Defense (DoD).  Strong qualifications with the full software design life cycle, including requirement analysis, prototyping, proof of concept, design, development, documentation, system integration, and test evaluation of large and complex systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of SARSAT (Search and Rescue Satellite Aided Tracking) Project, responsible for enhancement new capabilities and maintenance Alert Subsystem; this includes diagnostic problems, coding, and testing system using C++ language. The SARSAT system uses NOAA satellites in low-earth and geostationary orbits to detect and locate aviators, mariners, and land-based users in distress. The satellites relay distress signals from emergency beacons to a network of ground stations and ultimately to the	U.S.	Mission	Control	Center	(USMCC)
As a member of EOS Project, Lead all software testing activities for performance testing (Distributed Active Archive Centers –DAAC - like Operator Center) of the Real-time Command System for the Earth Core System Maintenance Development (EMD) project at Goddard Space Flight Center.
Developed scripts, utilities, simulators, data sets and other programmatic test tools as required to execute Test Plans using Perl, C, C++, C-Shell (csh), HTML, and Korn Shell (ksh).
Analyzed the Earth Science Data Information Systems (ESDIS)  data archived in the StorNext properly and identify software functional issues. Excellent analytical skills and problem solving skills.
Managed the testing of software and data systems that includes ingesting, distributing, analyzing and inspecting requirements and write test cases, test, execute test cases, create test reports, and create defects.
Performed system configuration, diagnose, troubleshoot system to resolve problems uncovered by testing, and assess test results by verifying and quantifying test coverage and test progress.
Conducted End to end functional tests, acceptance tests, operational tests, fault recovery tests, performance tests that benchmark the system stability and performance.
Very strong in performance testing life cycle and leadership skills.
Managed the testing of software and data systems that includes analyzing and inspecting requirements and write test cases.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of System Maintenance Development (EMD) project at Goddard Space Flight Center.
Troubleshooted and followed-up with user-generated maintenance requests and general issues.
Participated in Code Peer Reviews/Formal Inspections following the steps described in the Peer Review and verify that the action items have been satisfactorily dispositional.
Tuned system performance, developed unit test cases and performed unit testing to ensure functional accuracy and wrote NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) for any anomaly detected.
Prepared configuration setups and executed performance testing to validate EMD releases in test modes before promoting into operational mode at NASA.
Strong interpersonal skills to interact with customers and team members.
Reviewed business requirements and software system designs for testability.
Analyzed the EMD data archived in StorNext or AMASS to identify software functional issues. Interfaced with internal groups such as design, validation, testing under direction of software project manager. Resolved conflicts in requirements with customer and design engineers through Software Project Manager. Followed software project plan, schedules and action items using software process.
Wrote complex automated test scripts using scripting languages such as PERL, C-Shell (csh), Korn Shell (ksh).
Participated in various Six Sigma Projects, which defined processes and procedures as part of the Process Baseline Team in order to bring about process improvement within the program.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As member of System Performance Verification group: Developed test procedures, installed software, configured systems, debugged system problems, supported End-To-End tests at customer sites, performed tests, collected performance statistics network data, monitored system performance during End-To-End test at sites and prepared performance analysis reports.
Participated in test case peer reviews to ensure traceability specifications and test requirements.
As member of Software Development team: Designed the Data Management System (DMS) for the EOSDIS Core System (ECS) project at Goddard Space Flight Center. The project utilized POSIX-compliant operating systems, C++, Rogue Wave class libraries and Object Modeling Technique (OMT) methodology on SUN, HP & SGI platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Developed and implemented Ada programs to convert and validate incoming data from ADP systems external to Reserve Component Automation System (RCAS), and reformatted that data for RCAS using rules and information from supporting databases.  This included Rule analysis, presentation design, using the Teamwork design tool to create P-Spec, M-Spec, coding, testing, customizing Ada applications software to satisfy customer requirements, and participating in writing the Detailed Design Document.  
Participated in the design, coding, testing, and development Code Generator Tool to generate Ada code packages and preparation of the Software Design Document of the External Transaction Manager.  This component provided an interface between external JOPES databases and AWIS database using Object Oriented Design methodology based on the standard MIL-STD 2167A.  These operations translated incoming data to update the AWIS database, as well as reformatting data to send back to JOPES external databases.
